summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting the September 2, 2026 closing of its acquisition of Meals Through Seasons Limited (BVI) from Sellers Hongs Smart Limited and Yapjianhuei Smart Limited under an August 11, 2026 stock purchase agreement. Total consideration was US$510 million, payable entirely in securities: 150 million Class A ordinary shares at a US$1.00 reference price (US$150 million value) and US$360 million of unsecured convertible promissory notes, split 70/30 between the Sellers. The notes, divided into three US$120 million annual performance tranches, are convertible only if consolidated NPAT meets 50% of forecast thresholds. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The transaction closed with the Target Company's shares transferred to Ming Shing, which issued 105 million and 45 million shares to Hongs Smart and Yapjianhuei, respectively. What to watch: conversion of performance tranches depends on future NPAT results, creating earn-out-like mechanics; the all-stock/debt consideration signals no cash outlay, but note holders hold pari passu unsecured claims. No regulatory clock or risk-arb spread applies since the deal is closed; monitor post-closing integration and note conversion triggers.
